description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Pinnacle Solutions, an Akima company, is seeking a Game Developer to help create serious games using the Unity game engine. The role involves implementing gameplay features, using proprietary development tools, debugging issues, and collaborating with designers, artists, and developers.
Unity game developer collaborating on gameplay feature implementation and debugging gameplay and performance issues using proprietary tools

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with designers, artists, and senior developers to implement gameplay features
• Follow development standards using proprietary development tools
• Debug and resolve bugs, performance issues, and gameplay inconsistencies
• Participate in regular development reviews and team meetings. Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Game Development, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
• Knowledge of 2D/3D game mechanics
• Proficiency in one or more programming languages (C#, C++, etc.)
• Familiarity with the Unity game engine
• Strong problem-solving, analytical skills and attention to detail are a must
• Ability to work in a team and take constructive feedback
• Strong communication skills
• Must be a US Citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Clearance

Preferred:
• Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git, SVN, Perforce, etc)
• Basic knowledge of game physics, or AI systems
• Familiarity with agile development workflows
• Experience in AR/VR development
• Experience in the Lua programming language
• One or more shipped titles
